name: Johor Open 2016

information: Participant limit: 100 person. Please register on your own responsibility and make sure you will attend on the competition day, please inform the organizer with the email in contact information immedianty if you wish to cancel your registration. Fee: RM15 for the first event, RM4 for the second and following events. Please attend yourself at 8.00 am. for the sign in of competiton, and the first event will start within 8.30am. Other information will be update via our webpage, important information will be send through email.
